{{Quote|In the grave of Alderaan,<br />In the night of Charenthoth,<br />In the sands of Tatooine,<br />And the bloody hell of Hoth.<br /><br />We will meet the enemy;<br />We will sound the battle-cry.<br />With our comrades at our sides,<br />We will fight and we will die. ''[&hellip;]|Battle Chant of the Legion of Alderaan|<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
'''Charenthoth''' was a celestial body<ref name="RAS2" /> located in the [[Charenthoth system/Legends|Charenthoth system]], a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Battle Chant of the Legion of Alderaan|Battle Chant]] of the Alliance's [[Legion of Alderaan]] military unit mentioned the Rebels fighting the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] "in the night of Charenthoth," among other locales.<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Charenthoth was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Charenthoth [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
